name: checkpoint-admin-console
description: Local-only Checkpoint administration console (Angular SPA + local agent)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,server -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix web start" "npm --prefix server run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix web test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
